## Observed Facts

- **Count:** 20,217 BGL Log Entries contain "ciod" (case-insensitive substring on the message). Data Scope: BGL, 2005-06-01 to 2005-07-01 (end exclusive), no component or level filter [E1]. These are Log Entries, not incidents.
- **First match:** line 4988, 2005-06-03 16:17:40.190, node R26-M0-NC-I:J18-U11, component APP, level FATAL. The message is `ciod: Error loading /p/gb2/stella/RAPTOR/65641/raptor: invalid or missing program image, No such file or directory` [E1].
- **Just before (lines 4980–4987, Data Scope: BGL line_no 4980–4996):**
  - Lines 4980–4983, 16:12:35–36, node R16-M1-N2-C:J17-U01, KERNEL INFO: correctable-error (CE) symbol messages, ending with "total of 31 ddr error(s) detected and corrected" [E2].
  - Lines 4984–4987, 16:16:26, nodes on R22-M0, KERNEL INFO: "generating core.257", "core.385", "core.65" and "core.1" [E2].
  - The preceding entries are on different racks (R16, R22) from the first ciod entry (R26) [E2].
- **Just after (lines 4989–4996):** Eight more APP FATAL entries with the same "Error loading … raptor" message. They fall within about 0.26 s (16:17:40.232 to 16:17:40.445). They come from different nodes: R26-M0-NC-I, R26-M0-N8-I, R26-M0-N4-I, R26-M0-N0-I (each on J18-U01 and J18-U11), and R27-M1-NC-I:J18-U11 [E2].

## Hypotheses

- The same executable path (`/p/gb2/stella/RAPTOR/65641/raptor`) fails to load on many I/O nodes at once. That points to one job launch with a missing or inaccessible binary, for example a bad path, an unmounted or unavailable filesystem, or a file removed before launch. It doesn't look like a hardware fault.
- The preceding "generating core.N" entries (core dumps) and the DDR correctable-error messages are on other racks. They are probably unrelated, though they could be the end of an earlier job's crash. The logs don't show a link.

## Unknowns

- Whether all 20,217 matches share this error. I only looked at the first 5 rows and the surrounding context, not a breakdown by message.
- Whether the "generating core" entries on R22 belong to the same job as the RAPTOR launch.
- Why the file was missing or invalid. The logs show only the symptom.
- How the matches are spread over time. I haven't run a trend, so I can't say whether this is a single burst or recurring.

## Next Step

- Run `count_by` on component and node for "ciod" in this range, and a `trend` by hour or day, to see whether the 20,217 matches are one burst or recurring.
- Search for "raptor" and "No such file" in the same window to find how many nodes were affected.
- Outside the logs, check whether `/p/gb2/stella/RAPTOR/65641/raptor` existed and was readable on the file server at 2005-06-03 16:17.
